# Fotor

> Fotor is a comprehensive online photo editing and content creation platform offering AI-powered tools for image enhancement, background removal, collage making, and graphic design.

Fotor provides both a free web-based photo editor and professional APIs for developers. The platform combines traditional editing tools with advanced AI features including automatic enhancement, batch processing, and content generation capabilities.

## Key Topics

- AI Photo Editor
- Background Removal
- Image Enhancement
- Collage Maker
- Photo Effects
- Batch Processing
- AI APIs
- Image Upscaling
- Photo Retouching
- Video Editing
- Free Online Tools
- Graphic Design
- Text Overlay
- Image Resizing

## Core Photo Editing Tools

- [Photo Editor: Free Online Photo Editing & Image Editor | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com): Fotor's main photo editor with AI enhancement, cropping, effects, and batch processing
- [AI Photo Editor - Free Online Automatic AI Photo Editing | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/ai-photo-editor): Fotor's AI photo editor with automatic enhancement and AI text prompt editing
- [Photo Retouching | Retouch Photos Online for Free | Fotor Photo Editor](https://www.fotor.com/features/photo-retouching): Fotor's AI skin retouch with wrinkle removal, blemish removal, and beauty tools

## Image Manipulation & Effects

- [Free Photo Collage Maker Online: 2000+ Layouts & Photo Grids | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/collage): Fotor's collage maker with 2000+ templates and customizable photo grids
- [Add Photo Effects Online: Apply Artistic & Cinematic Filters | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/photo-effects): Fotor's photo effects tool with artistic and cinematic filters
- [Free Image Cropper: Crop Image Online with Custom & Preset Ratios | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/crop): Fotor's image cropper with custom and preset ratios for social media
- [Image Resizer: Simply Resize Images Online for Free | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/resize.html): Fotor's image resizer with batch processing for web and social media
- [Photo Frame Editor: Add Borders to Photo Online for Free | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/frames): Fotor's frame editor for adding customizable borders and frames to photos

## Text & Design Features

- [Add Text to Photo Online: Free Text Adder | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/text.html): Fotor's text adder tool for adding fonts and text overlays to images

## Developer APIs

- [Advanced AI APIs to Empower Content-Centric Businesses | Fotor](https://developers.fotor.com): Fotor's AI APIs for background removal, photo enhancement, and image generation

## Pricing & Plans

- [Pricing | Fotor - Photo Editing & Collage Maker & Graphic Design](https://www.fotor.com/pricing): Fotor Pro and Pro+ subscription plans with AI tools pricing
